You must NOT run blind-player.spec.js (billed, needs staging).

FIRST STEP: this worktree lacks an earlier change that is not committed. Apply it before anything else: git apply /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/affordance-l2-semantic/base.patch . It adds turnRecord() and semantic_matches to blind-player.js, the spec and the test. Keep all of it.

PROBLEM: the L2 report is huge and hard to read because each replicate's `transcript` array holds the whole on-screen transcript again after every turn (it grows quadratically; 252 KB for 3 replicates). Nothing reads that array back.

REPORT CONTRACT (both tasks rely on it, written exactly): each L2 replicate record in artifacts/e2e-blind-player.json no longer has the cumulative `transcript` array. It keeps `opening_text`, `commands`, `prompts` and every analyseRun field (including `stuck_turns`, an array of turn numbers, and `semantic_matches`), and gains `turns`: an array with one object per turn, {turn: number, input: string, text: string, rejected: boolean, rejection: string|null, scene_id: string|null, semantic_match: {ran: boolean, matched: string|null}|null, grounding_ids: string[]}. `text` is only that turn's new response text (the same `text` the spec already builds from the response segments), never the earlier turns.

CHANGE: (1) In blind-player.js add and export `turnLog(turns)` that maps the spec's turn records (each {turn, input, text, state, grounding_ids, delivery, semantic_match, prompt, rejected?, rejection?}) to the `turns` objects in the contract (scene_id = state?.scene_id ?? null; rejected = Boolean(rejected); rejection = rejection ?? null; semantic_match = semantic_match ?? null; never include `prompt`, `delivery` or `state`). (2) In blind-player.spec.js remove the `transcripts` array and its push, drop `transcript: transcripts` from the replicate record, and add `turns: turnLog(turns)`. Keep `opening_text`, `prompts` and everything else. (3) In blind-player.js formatMarkdown the markdown must keep not printing prompts; the report JSON embedded in it now holds `turns` instead of `transcript`, which is intended. Add a short per-replicate '## Turns' list to the markdown instead: one line per turn `- t<N> <input> -> <first 200 characters of text, single line>`.

TESTS in blind-player.test.js: turnLog on a normal turn, a rejected turn, and a turn with and without semantic_match; the key set is exactly the contract and no prompt leaks; formatMarkdown prints the Turns lines and truncates long text; existing tests stay passing.

HOW TO RUN (worktree root): cd frontend && node --test e2e/*.test.js . If frontend/node_modules is missing: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules (never npm install). Also: E2E_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 npx playwright test --list --grep @blind-player

PROBLEM: scripts/ringer/affordance/digest.py prints only rates and stuck runs for an L2 report, so reading what the player did and what the game answered each turn needs ad hoc scripts. It also runs its code at import time (it reads sys.argv[1] at module level), so it cannot be tested.

REPORT CONTRACT (both tasks rely on it, written exactly): each L2 replicate record in artifacts/e2e-blind-player.json no longer has the cumulative `transcript` array. It keeps `opening_text`, `commands`, `prompts` and every analyseRun field (including `stuck_turns`, an array of turn numbers, and `semantic_matches`), and gains `turns`: an array with one object per turn, {turn: number, input: string, text: string, rejected: boolean, rejection: string|null, scene_id: string|null, semantic_match: {ran: boolean, matched: string|null}|null, grounding_ids: string[]}. `text` is only that turn's new response text (the same `text` the spec already builds from the response segments), never the earlier turns.

CHANGE: (1) Restructure digest.py into functions plus `main(argv=None)` guarded by `if __name__ == "__main__":`; keep `python3 scripts/ringer/affordance/digest.py <report.json>` working with the same output for L1 reports and the same header lines for L2. Keep the code compatible with python3 (no third-party imports). (2) For L2, after each replicate's existing lines, print a per-turn block, one line per turn: `  t<N> <flags> <input> -> <text>` where flags is a short bracketed list drawn from: `stuck` when N is in the replicate's stuck_turns, `rej` when the turn is rejected (and then print the rejection text instead of the response), `sem:ran` / `sem:match=<id>` from semantic_match (`sem:ran` when ran is true and matched is null, nothing when semantic_match is null or ran is false... print `sem:off` when ran is false), and `L`/`T` not needed. text is the turn's text on one line, cut to 240 characters with an ellipsis; with a `--full` flag (argv after the path) print the whole text. (3) A report without `turns` (the old format, which has `commands` instead) must still print: use the commands for the per-turn lines with `(old report: no response text)`. Never crash on missing keys. (4) In tests/test_affordance_digest.py load digest.py with importlib from its path (scripts is not a package) and test: an L2 report with turns (flags stuck, rej, sem:ran, sem:match, sem:off; truncation; --full), an old-format L2 report, and an L1 report unchanged. Use capsys. Build the reports inline as dicts and write them to tmp_path.

HOW TO RUN (worktree root): TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q tests/test_affordance_digest.py --no-cov . Also run `uv run ruff check scripts/ringer/affordance/digest.py tests/test_affordance_digest.py && uv run ruff format scripts/ringer/affordance/digest.py tests/test_affordance_digest.py`.

OUTPUT: write ./notes.md at the worktree root (not git-added): the files changed and a short summary.
